findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_facts, page_to_markdown, whois, merchant_check, counterparty_check · Private data: domain_facts, sanctions_screen, lei_lookup, whois, sanctions_address, counterparty_check · Public sink: health, domain_facts, page_to_markdown, whois, merchant_check, counterparty_check · Destructive: counterparty_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_facts, page_to_markdown, whois, merchant_check, counterparty_check · Private data: domain_facts, sanctions_screen, lei_lookup, whois, sanctions_address, counterparty_check · Public sink: health, domain_facts, page_to_markdown, whois, merchant_check, counterparty_check · Destructive: counterparty_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
